obligations.name: BlobDigest canonical encoding
obligations.requirement: SHA-256 digest bytes and exact byte count round-trip through one canonical representation.

obligations.name: BlobDigest malformed rejection
obligations.requirement: Unknown algorithms, wrong digest lengths, noncanonical integers and byte-count mismatch fail closed before allocation or publication.

obligations.name: Opaque partition construction
obligations.requirement: AkashicCore exposes no public initializer from user, account, URL or Fovea namespace strings.

obligations.name: Partition logical isolation
obligations.requirement: The same BlobDigest in two partitions never creates cross-partition logical visibility or removal authority.

obligations.name: Stage remains invisible
obligations.requirement: A successfully staged blob is not observable through read, physicalID or maintenance references before publish.

obligations.name: Publish single terminal transition
obligations.requirement: One BlobStage reaches one published terminal state; duplicate publish cannot create duplicate visibility or corrupt the manifest.

obligations.name: Discard idempotent terminal state
obligations.requirement: Repeated discard is safe and no discarded stage can later publish or remain reachable after reopen.

obligations.name: Same-partition duplicate commit
obligations.requirement: A duplicate verified digest in one partition follows the declared reuse rule without duplicate logical entries or integrity bypass.

obligations.name: No cross-partition physical deduplication
obligations.requirement: The first independent release does not reuse one physical blob across different CachePartitionID values.

obligations.name: Store recomputes digest
obligations.requirement: Stage and commit reject caller bytes that do not match BlobDigest even when all metadata and paths are otherwise valid.

obligations.name: Publication crash switch matrix
obligations.requirement: Crashes after write, file fsync, rename, manifest write and directory fsync recover to either old or new complete state, never partial visibility.

obligations.name: Future schema fail closed
obligations.requirement: Unknown manifest, pointer or generation schema remains untouched and is not overwritten by an older implementation.

obligations.name: Orphan reconciliation
obligations.requirement: Unpublished or unreferenced physical files are recovered or removed within declared bounds without deleting live blobs.

obligations.name: Generation pointer recovery
obligations.requirement: CURRENT pointer creation, replacement and fallback select only a complete compatible StoreGenerationID.

obligations.name: External mutation quarantine
obligations.requirement: Delete, truncate, replace or corrupt of a managed blob produces structured integrity failure, logical quarantine and bounded recovery.

obligations.name: Link ownership and permission defense
obligations.requirement: Symlink, hardlink, wrong owner, wrong file type and unsafe permissions are rejected without following attacker-controlled paths.

obligations.name: Opaque locator boundary
obligations.requirement: PhysicalBlobID cannot inject a path, escape the store root or act as content identity or authorization.

obligations.name: Bounded maintenance inputs
obligations.requirement: GC and usage operations reject excessive reference counts, byte totals and directory work before unbounded allocation or scan.

obligations.name: Storage resource envelope
obligations.requirement: Retained workloads report peak RSS, file descriptors, bytes read/written, metadata amplification and reopen latency under declared limits.

obligations.name: Single active writer lease
obligations.requirement: A second process cannot mutate the same active store generation while the first writer lease is held; owner exit permits bounded recovery.

obligations.name: Reader scope is explicit
obligations.requirement: The first release supports in-process concurrent readers under actor/store synchronization and makes no untested multi-process reader guarantee.

obligations.name: ContentID to BlobDigest equivalence
obligations.requirement: Fovea maps a validated ContentID to exactly the same SHA-256 byte domain and byte count expected by Akashic.

obligations.name: Record publication failure leaves orphan only
obligations.requirement: Blob publication followed by representation-record failure never creates a cache hit and leaves only a bounded collectible orphan.

obligations.name: Revoke versus publish race
obligations.requirement: A revoked NamespaceGeneration cannot become reachable through a late blob or record publication.

obligations.name: Cache write failure preserves final delivery
obligations.requirement: Storage failure does not convert an otherwise valid network decode into user-visible load failure when policy permits nonpersistent delivery.

obligations.name: Custom store cannot forge host identity
obligations.requirement: A custom store physical locator or publication result cannot bypass Fovea digest verification, partition projection or record eligibility checks.

obligations.name: Memory cache reference-model differential
obligations.requirement: MemoryCache operations and removal summaries match a bounded reference model under generated sequential and concurrent histories.

obligations.name: Memory pressure purge accounting
obligations.requirement: Purge and limit changes report exact removed count/cost and never retain an oversized entry outside policy.

obligations.name: Independent consumer and API baseline
obligations.requirement: External consumers can import Core, Memory and Disk independently while package-internal fault hooks and Fovea terminology remain absent from public API.

obligations.name: Version compatibility matrix
obligations.requirement: Current and previous supported Fovea/Akashic versions classify contract and disk changes as compatible, new-generation, breaking or inconclusive.

P3: typed contract names and canonical encodings frozen
disk, deduplication and writer policies fixed
P4: AKASHIC-CT-004 through AKASHIC-CT-021 and AKASHIC-CT-027 through AKASHIC-CT-029 pass
clean source and protected CI evidence exist
P5: Fovea consumes external exact pin through adapters
W3, W8 and W13 show no semantic regression
